notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - There she blows!
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2
[list]
[*] Launcher now allows you to set Texture Size and Vertical Sync Type
[*] Universal Shaders - Now compile on OpenGL/ES (can remove [b]SuperVignetteOff[/b] on laptops)
[*] Can no longer select a wrong facing Lift waypoint.
[*] Sleeping Rusty on Lifts no longer forgets how to get off.
[*] Rusty will sleep longer on spawn to let you look around more.
[*] Stop Rusty Teleporting backwards when hit by a lift from behind.
[*] Console window turned off (will not report error, just log it).
[*] Various minor fixes and tweaks.
[/list]

You should find that you can now remove the temporary "[b]SuperVignetteOff[/b]" flag if running on a laptop onboard GPU (for the people who got stuck after the loading screen). The new shaders should be good for all versions of OpenGL2.0/ES. Setting the Texture Size to "Lo" will also help people with limited GPU memory.

vSync Adapt (Adaptive Vertical Sync) will lock the game to the vertical sync until the framerate drops below 60.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 lives!
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1

* Fixed framerate spike issue on some of the bigger end levels.
* Fixed a rare crash if a Wat falls onto a collapsing platform. 
* Fixed issue with Rusty falling off a lift if a frame spike happened.
* Starting a level with unbanked brains only triggers reminder once.
* Quitting a level with unbanked brains will only trigger the reminder once.
* The grid will now turn green when placing a platform next to an existing one.
* Rusty jumping off a burning/falling platform will now go into correct fall.
* Minor fixes
